description: This file defines the UIService which manages real-time UI updates via SSE, including node summaries, detailed node info, MCP health, event broadcasting with deduplication, and status reconciliation, for a control plane under the 'services' package.

classes.name: NodeEvent
classes.description: Represents a real-time event related to an agent node, used for SSE broadcasting.

classes.name: UIService
classes.description: Provides real-time data for UI via SSE, manages clients, deduplicates events, handles node status reconciliation, MCP health integration, and keeps clients updated.

classes.name: AgentNodeSummaryForUI
classes.description: A subset of agent node info optimized for UI display, including status and MCP summary.

classes.name: NodeDetailsWithPackageInfo
classes.description: Enhanced node detail with optional package info associated via configuration schema.

classes.name: PackageInfo
classes.description: Basic package metadata associated with nodes for detailed display.

methods.name: NewUIService
methods.description: Constructor to create a new UIService instance, starts heartbeat mechanism.

methods.name: GetNodesSummary
methods.description: Retrieves summarized status info of all nodes with fallback status reconciliation.

methods.name: getReconciledNodeStatus
methods.description: Provides a consistent status for a node using cache, agent service, or fallback logic.

methods.name: GetNodeDetails
methods.description: Fetches full details of a node from storage.

methods.name: GetNodeDetailsWithPackageInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed node info along with associated package data.

methods.name: findPackageByNodeID
methods.description: Internal method to locate the package corresponding to a node via configuration schema.

methods.name: RegisterClient
methods.description: Registers a new SSE client and returns a channel for event subscription.

methods.name: DeregisterClient
methods.description: Removes an SSE client and closes its channel.

methods.name: BroadcastEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts events to all clients with deduplication and error handling.

methods.name: OnAgentRegistered
methods.description: Handles agent registration event, broadcasting new node info.

methods.name: OnNodeStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles status changes, broadcasting updated node state and reasoner updates.

methods.name: OnReasonerStatusChanged
methods.description: Broadcasts reasoner-specific status changes for instant UI updates.

methods.name: OnAgentRemoved
methods.description: Handles agent removal event, broadcasting deletion.

methods.name: fetchMCPHealthForNode
methods.description: Fetches MCP health info for a node via agent client, transforms data mode-specific.

methods.name: GetNodeDetailsWithMCP
methods.description: Fetches comprehensive node info including MCP health based on mode.

methods.name: enhanceNodeSummaryWithMCP
methods.description: Adds MCP health summary to node summaries, calls MCP API if active.

methods.name: OnMCPHealthChanged
methods.description: Callback handling MCP health change notification, broadcasts event.

methods.name: startHeartbeat
methods.description: Initiates periodic heartbeat events to keep SSE connections alive.

methods.name: StopHeartbeat
methods.description: Stops the heartbeat ticker.

methods.name: isDuplicateEvent
methods.description: Checks if event is a duplicate based on type and recent cache, for deduplication.

methods.name: cacheEvent
methods.description: Stores event in cache for deduplication.

methods.name: getEventCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for an event based on its type and contents.

methods.name: compareStatusEvents
methods.description: Checks if two status events are effectively the same to skip duplicates.

methods.name: RefreshNodeStatus
methods.description: Triggers status refresh via status manager.

methods.name: GetUnifiedNodeStatus
methods.description: Gets the current unified status of a node.

methods.name: GetNodeUnifiedStatus
methods.description: Alias for GetUnifiedNodeStatus.

methods.name: BulkNodeStatus
methods.description: Gets statuses for multiple nodes concurrently.

methods.name: RefreshAllNodeStatus
methods.description: Refreshes statuses for all registered nodes with concurrency control.
